title: When in financial difficulty
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكفني بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
translation: O Allah, provide me lawful livelihood adequate to my needs instead of an ill-gotten one, and grant me freedom from needing anything from anyone besides Yourself.

title: When seeing someone in distress (say softly)
arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلَاكَ بِهِ وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِّمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلاً
translation: All praise is due to Allah who granted me safety from what He has afflicted you with and has favored me over many of His creation.

title: Dua for fever
arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الْكَبِيرِ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ عِرْقٍ نَعَّارٍ وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَرِّ النَّارِ
translation: In the name of Allah, the Great, I seek protection in Allah, the Magnificent, from the evil of every throbbing vein and the evil of the heat of the Fire.

title: When visiting the sick
arabic: لَا بَأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ اللَّهُمَّ اشْفِهِ اللَّهُمَّ عَافِهِ
translation: Do not despair, it is a purification (from sins) if Allah wills. O Allah, grant him a cure and well-being.

title: At the time of death
arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى غَمَرَاتِ الْمَوْتِ وَسَكَرَاتِ الْمَوْتِ
translation: There is no god but Allah. Muhammad is the messenger of Allah. O Allah, help me to overcome the agonies and difficulties of death.

title: Thanaa in Janazah Salaah
arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكَ وَجَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ
translation: Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise be to You; blessed is Your Name, exalted is Your Majesty, and there is no god besides You.

title: Dua in Janazah for an adult
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِحَيِّنَا وَمَيِّتِنَا وَشَاهِدِنَا وَغَائِبِنَا وَصَغِيرِنَا وَكَبِيرِنَا وَذَكَرِنَا وَأُنْثَانَا، اللَّهُمَّ مَنْ أَحْيَيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَأَحْيِهِ عَلَى الْإِسْلَامِ، وَمَنْ تَوَفَّيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَتَوَفَّهُ عَلَى الْإِيمَانِ
translation: O Allah, forgive our living and our dead, those present and those absent, our young and our old, our males and our females. O Allah, whom You keep alive among us, keep him alive on Islam, and whom You cause to die, let him die on faith.

title: Janazah Dua for a boy
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ لَنَا فَرَطًا، وَاجْعَلْهُ لَنَا أَجْرًا وَذُخْرًا، وَاجْعَلْهُ لَنَا شَافِعًا وَمُشَفَّعًا
translation: O Allah, make him our forerunner, a source of reward and treasure, and make him an intercessor whose intercession is accepted.

title: Janazah Dua for a girl
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهَا لَنَا فَرَطًا، وَاجْعَلْهَا لَنَا أَجْرًا وَذُخْرًا، وَاجْعَلْهَا لَنَا شَافِعَةً وَمُشَفَّعَةً
translation: O Allah, make her our forerunner, a source of reward and treasure, and make her an intercessor whose intercession is accepted.

title: When entering the graveyard
arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لَاحِقُونَ، نَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمُ الْعَافِيَةَ
translation: Peace be upon you, O dwellers of these homes, from among the believers and Muslims. Indeed, we shall, if Allah wills, be joining you. We ask Allah for well-being for you and for us.

title: When laying the dead into the grave
arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ
translation: In the name of Allah and upon the religion of the Messenger of Allah do we lay this body to rest.

title: When filling the grave with soil
arabic:
مِنْهَا خَلَقْنَاكُمْ
وَفِيهَا نُعِيدُكُمْ
وَمِنْهَا نُخْرِجُكُمْ تَارَةً أُخْرَى
translation: From it (the earth) We created you. And into it We shall return you. And from it We shall bring you out once again.

title: Dua for parents
translation: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up [when I was] small.
